DF-012.Name: ReleasePipeline
DF-012.Summary: GitHub Actions workflow `release.yml` fires on tag push in xronocode/mark. Matrix: macos-14 (arm64, BLOCKING), macos-13 (x86_64, BLOCKING), ubuntu-latest (continue-on-error: true), windows-latest (continue-on-error: true). Each job: `yarn install`, build (`yarn build` or `tauri build`), macOS sign (`codesign --force --deep --sign - Mark.app`). Packages artifacts as DMG/ZIP (macOS, required), AppImage/deb (Linux, best effort), NSIS/MSI (Windows, best effort). `gh release create` publishes artifacts + auto-generated notes on xronocode/mark. Separate job opens PR to xronocode/homebrew-mark updating Casks/mark.rb version + sha256 (automated via actions-user token; user reviews and merges).
